root_cause_repairs.finding: The /cases runtime did not expose the corrected waiting-for-client composition as a first-class view; the legacy list mixed status scope, toolbar controls and row columns.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Added an explicit waiting view driven by normalizeCaseStatus(record.status) === waiting_on_client, with a disabled canonical status filter, real waiting metrics, reference-aligned tabs, toolbar, nine-column list and route-specific row action surface.

root_cause_repairs.finding: Waiting rows lacked a safe, data-dependent contact/next-step presentation and the surrounding table could collapse into unreadable text at the observed viewport.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Derived missing/waiting/reminder/next-step values from available case data, exposed tel/mailto/detail actions only when their real source exists, and added route-scoped responsive grid/wrapping rules with internal table scrolling.

rules: Waiting counts, metrics, rows, labels, links and actions remain derived from real workspace case/client data and canonical status helpers.
No screenshot fixture, reference row, hardcoded reference count or fake waiting success path was introduced.
The only production test-data mutation was an explicitly authorized visible-form creation of one test case; no raw database/API mutation or destructive action was used.
Semantic colors and icons resolve through shared Visual SOT owners and --cf-vst-* tokens; no stage-specific repeated color literals were added.
No unrelated route, table, RLS, function, trigger or production merge was performed.
